description: The checks spec/audit.py runs per repository, in the order it runs them. Each id names the function check_<id> with every dot and hyphen as an underscore. scope repo runs once, baseline reads each baseline file of spec/files.json, and file runs on each baseline file that baseline read. hub false skips the hub's own audit. ground false still runs when the ground-truth branch is absent. suppression marks a check a driftNote naming its id suppresses, until the repository declares endsWithType, or on every repository where that is null.

checks.description: main exists, and the registry's hasDevelop matches whether develop does.
Paths changed on main that develop is behind on or has diverged from.
The repository's general settings match the fleet's.
The main and develop rulesets match the workflow model's payloads, with no stray ruleset.
A tree carrying .py files declares the python type.
Every tracked .py file sits inside a directory the registry declares.
A root tests/ suite has the manifest the undeclared root default needs to run it.
Each script file name takes the stem its extension sets.
Each tracked env and secret file name takes the form the env and secret file rule sets.
The secret names each store holds against those the applicable mechanisms require and forbid.
dependabot.yml declares each ecosystem the tree implies.
Each baseline file, or a declared alternative, is present, with its intent staleness advisory.
An interface workflow keeps its contract's job keys, check name, and tokens.
A caller's python-directories input matches the registry's pythonDirectories.
The pull request caller's workflow-model input matches the registry's workflowModel.
The publisher's and the merge-bot's concurrency group is the one WORKFLOW.md pins.
Each job a contract pins verbatim matches the hub canonical.
A verbatim file matches the hub canonical.
Each section a Markdown file owes is present as a heading.
Each verbatim section matches the hub canonical.
A carried instruction file holds no level-two heading the manifest does not declare.
A carried instruction file names the hub only inside its verbatim sections.
An instruction document carries no version literal or commit SHA.
The repository's file tree was read in full.
Each manifest-owned tree matches its hub source.
The repository carries no hub-hosted file the manifest leaves undeclared.
HISTORY.md opens with the README's title and tagline.
The README title and tagline, and the About and Docker Hub descriptions they mirror to.
The README's sections, in order.
The README's shields, by class and placement.
The README's reference links, by name, group, and order.
Each cataloged tool the README lists carries the catalog's link and description.
No workspace file duplicates cspell.json's word list.
Each driftNote's check id and pending claim, read against the findings before it.
